nodes.name: Gradient descent
nodes.definition: An iterative algorithm that updates parameters along the negative gradient of the loss.

evidence.quote: updates parameters in the direction of the negative gradient of the loss

nodes.name: Activation functions
nodes.definition: Functions such as ReLU that add non-linearity to a network.

evidence.quote: introduce non-linearity so that a network can represent more than a linear map

nodes.name: Chain rule
nodes.definition: The derivative of a composite function is the product of the derivatives of its parts.

evidence.quote: compute the derivative of a composite function by multiplying the derivatives of its parts

nodes.name: Backpropagation
nodes.definition: Applies the chain rule layer by layer to get the gradient of the loss for every weight.

evidence.quote: applies the chain rule layer by layer from the output back to the input
